gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-lao-l: Capture It towers with round bowls drawn in one unvarying line. Noto Sans Lao Looped leaves its bowls unfinished on one side, which loosens the sealed, towering heading into something easier to move through.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-mayan: Tight, tall, urban: Capture It draws towering letters with no thick-thin shift and openings nearly sealed shut. Noto Sans Mayan Numerals, with its gaping c, pries the page back open.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-medef: Noto Sans Medefaidrin reads tall and open, with curves that never pool ink. Against the nearly sealed letters of Capture It, that openness creates the tension, shut tight above and open below.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-modi: Noto Sans Modi lets daylight into every curve, and its capitals and lowercase sit close in height. Capture It stays up top, sealed and towering, while a full page of the body would flow smoothly.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-mro: Bent-paperclip lettering, Capture It runs towering and nearly sealed, with no thick-thin shifts at all. But Noto Sans Mro, dense and tall in the middle yet wide at the entrances, reads smoothly line after line.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-nabat: Noto Sans Nabataean reads big and open, its lowercase standing nearly as tall as its capitals. But Capture It above is cut like a router bit and nearly shut, so the text below feels freer.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-nag-m: Noto Sans Nag Mundari looks half unwrapped, its lowercase rivaling the capitals. Below Capture It, whose rounded-nib letters stay tightly sealed and towering, that looseness supplies a welcome counterweight.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Noto Sans Ogham looks bold for lowercase because its bodies run tall, with wide gaps in the e. And Capture It, with a constant outline and nearly sealed letters, tightens up what the body opens.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-old-i: Capture It's towering x-height crowds its letters nearly shut. Noto Sans Old Italic keeps its lowercase close to cap height too, yet holds its curve endings well apart, so the two share stature but not openness.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-old-s: Noto Sans Old Sogdian is tall and crisp, its wide mouths staying sharp when shrunk. Noto Sans Old Sogdian then gives Capture It, with its uniform strokes and sealed shapes, room to breathe.
